Who will you meet at PG Connects London 2027?
Companies already confirmed to attend include BBC, Blizzard Entertainment, EA, Games Workshop, Google, ITV, Meta, Snap, Square Enix, Tiktok, Unity, Warhammer
By
Steve Takle
November 24, 2026

In the New Year, more than 3,000 attendees from 70+ countries are expected to gather in the UK to Connect and do business at
PG Connects London
. Our flagship event of the year returns on January 18th and 19th, 2027 with an audience comprising nearly 70% game makers – more than half being C-level leaders. It's a veritable must-meet roster of key decision makers.
Just some of the companies already confirmed to attend in 2027 include BBC, Blizzard Entertainment, Electronic Arts, Games Workshop, Google, ITV, LEGO, Meta, Pokemon, Snap, Square Enix, Tiktok, Unity, Warhammer, and many more.
You can see the full list of
this year's attendees
to get an idea of the kind of companies you could meet. Below, you’ll find the first companies you could meet in London on January 18th and 19th, 2027 with more signing up daily. We’ll update this list as the event approaches, so bookmark it and check back often.
